title: Mixed Event — The Warmth of Intersecting Melodies — Episode1 In the Face of the Last One

meta.Episode: Episode1 — In the Face of the Last One
meta.Event Outline: Ichika has her eye on the last copy of a CD by an artist who creates Miku songs, but so does a fellow shopper—a girl with long hair. Surprisingly, the girl allows Ichika to take it. Putting the pieces together, Mafuyu realizes the girl in question was Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Thank you for helping me carry all this, Asahina. I should be able to take it from here. I know you're very busy.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Please feel free to ask again if you ever need help with anything else.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Next is class representative business...
I'm running a little late. I'll need to hurry.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sorry for being late, Hoshino. I didn't mean to keep you waiting.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's okay. That actually gave me some time to get my papers in order. Anyway, shall we begin?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If I recall... Oh, we were tallying up survey responses from every school event that's been held thus far.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, and many students have been saying, “The event was fun.” Getting ready for the Sports Festival and choir recital in quick succession wasn't easy, but it seems like they all enjoyed working together.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That's good to hear.
It's a nice change from how a large plurality of the student body voiced a dissenting opinion last year.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Quite a few second and third years seemed to enjoy things but felt conflicted about not using that time to study for entrance exams...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
Yes, it is almost that time of year.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It is. And when you become a second year, everyone begins pressuring you about what you'll be doing in the future.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: At the same time, it'd be nice to keep organizing events that are both fun and accommodating in terms of the needs of others.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I agree.
These are special events, so they should have a special place in everyone's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Anyway, shall we review proposals for the next event while going through these survey responses?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, we have some strong candidates now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But we'll need to edit this more before passing it on to the rest of the student council or the teachers... That may take a while.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hoshino, would you have time to...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Is everything okay?
You can go if there's a pressing matter you need to attend to.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry...
It's not that urgent or anything, but the new CD for this artist I like goes on sale today...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. They retired from producing VIRTUAL SINGER music for a little while, but decided to return recently.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They're not all that famous, but have a fairly strong following... And they even played some of their music at the Fan Festival this year.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! You're going to the Fan Festival?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This artist who went into retirement for a while is going to be there, so I'd like to hear their music.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, could it be...? Was this artist's music difficult to come by before they retired?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Gasp*...!
Yes, that's right!
Do you like them too, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, a friend actually told me about them. I remember because they seemed to really like this artist as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see.
It's nice knowing that there really are other fans out there.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm just as surprised as you are.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And you've been looking forward to getting their CD right as it goes on sale, yes?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yes... But this is also a limited version that you can't buy online, so I may never be able to get this CD if I miss this opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There was no way to make any reservations either, so I've been worried about it selling out... I'm sorry. I didn't mean for it to get in the way of what we're doing now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But you seem genuinely concerned, so why don't we put a hold on things for now...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. I suspect that your mind will be elsewhere even if we were to continue, but we nearly have everything ready so we can leave the rest until tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I can clean up here, so you go on ahead, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much!
I really appreciate it, Asahina.
I'll see you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I wonder if Kanade's going to buy it too...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Huff*... *Huff*...
Okay, the new CDs should be...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, there's one left.
Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm sorry. You're here for this, yes?
Please, take it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: N-No, I couldn't. You had it first so...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, it's okay.
Please, don't mind me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I've heard most of the songs on this already online, and...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want as many people to hear this person's music as possible.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<K, is something wrong?
You don't sound too well.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, weren't you saying that you're getting that new CD today? Did the shop run out or something?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <No, there was one left, but this other person seemed to really want it so...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, now I see...
Bad timing, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Can't you get it online?
What about other stores?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <No, it's not available online and it's only being carried by a few shops. There aren't many that do around here, so I may've missed my chance for good...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It's supposed to include songs with scores written by the artist, so I was really hoping to use it for reference later...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But I did feel a little happy in the end...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The person who ended up buying that copy seemed like they were really looking forward to getting it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That means they're probably as big a fan of them as you, K.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Right. It was nice to meet another fan and I'm happy as long as they get to enjoy it...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But you wanted to listen to it too, right, K? I mean, you never know. They might do a re-release, so I'll check online for any info.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I'll see who else is selling it.>
